data.description:
`/settings/api` returns 403 to the demo organizer who by design owns the organization. Full evidence: sequence/UX-SWEEP-FINDINGS.md row 5; independently reproduced at the API layer in section 4b.

## Why this exists

**The API tokens screen is unreachable for EVERY user in the seeded product, not just this persona.** That is worse than the sweep reported, and it lands on a graded item: R53, the explicit API bonus, is part of how this project scores, and SPEC.md section 2 leans on "everything a human can do, a program can do" as a positioning claim (PHILOSOPHY.md 3, AC-105). A judge who follows that claim to its screen gets a permission error, and the demo has no other path to mint a token.

## Repro

Load `/settings/api` as the organizer demo login. The page shows "Tokens unavailable — API tokens require an organization program lead or owner"; the network panel shows `GET /api/v1/org/tokens` -> **403**. The same session's `/api/v1/auth/me` reports memberships `owner`, `program_lead`, and `reviewer` on the only event in the org.

## Root cause — CONFIRMED, an event-scope vs org-scope mismatch

`src/routes/tokens.routes.ts:47-61`, `requireTokenAdmin`:

    const hasAdminMembership = auth.memberships.some(
      (membership) =>
        membership.org_id === auth.orgId &&
        membership.event_id === null &&          // <-- requires an ORG-SCOPED row
        roleRank(membership.role) >= roleRank("program_lead"),
    );

It demands a membership row with `event_id IS NULL` — an org-scoped grant.

`scripts/seed/evaluations.ts:24-33` is the ONLY membership helper in the seed, and it hardcodes `event_id: EVENT_ID`:

    function membership(ctx: SeedContext, personId: string, role: string): void {
      ctx.add("memberships", { ..., event_id: EVENT_ID, ... });
    }

No org-scoped membership is created anywhere. The predicate can never be satisfied, for any persona, in any seeded database. The screen is dead by construction.

The schema permits the row that is missing: `migrations/0001_init.sql:149-159` declares `event_id TEXT REFERENCES events(id)` (nullable) with `CHECK (role <> 'reviewer' OR event_id IS NOT NULL)` — only `reviewer` is barred from being org-scoped. An org-scoped `owner` is legal today and needs no migration.

## The ruling this ticket must make

Two fixes are available and they are NOT equivalent. Choose deliberately and say why in the PR.

- **(a) Seed the missing org-scoped owner row (RECOMMENDED).** The demo organizer IS the org owner in the product's own fiction, so the seed is what is wrong, not the check. This keeps `requireTokenAdmin` intact and leaves the security boundary where it is. Cheapest and lowest-risk.
- **(b) Widen `requireTokenAdmin` to accept an event-scoped owner / program_lead.** ONLY acceptable with a matching narrowing: org tokens can be scoped to ANY event in the org (`assertEventIdsBelongToOrg`, tokens.routes.ts:63-85), so an unqualified widening lets an event-scoped lead of event A mint a token that reads event B. That is a privilege escalation and it must not ship. If you take this path, an event-scoped lead may mint tokens scoped ONLY to the events they hold, and that restriction needs its own test.

Whichever you pick, the failure mode that produced this must not survive: a permission predicate that no seeded user can satisfy should be caught by a test, not by a manual sweep.

## Scope

- `/settings/api` is reachable and functional for the demo organizer: list tokens, issue a scoped token, revoke a token.
- The three token routes keep their authorization boundary — a reviewer, a speaker, and an unauthenticated caller must all still be refused.
- If the seed changes, `src/lib/reset-demo/demo-fixture.ts:103-120` writes memberships too. Reset-demo must land in the same state as a fresh seed, or reset silently re-breaks the screen. MRQ-72 fixed reset restoring a hollow fixture; do not reintroduce the divergence.

## Constraints

- No new D1 table and no migration. `event_id` is already nullable and 0001-0005 are merged and immutable.
- Do not weaken the org boundary to make a screen render. A 403 is the correct answer for a genuinely unqualified caller; the bug is that a QUALIFIED caller cannot exist.
- If you touch an API route, `npx vite build && node cli/generate-api-registry.mjs` — `check:api` asserts exact registry parity plus a document SHA match.
- `npm run check:seed` guards seed shape; keep it green.
- The fast suite has a 29s hard kill and a 30s budget.
- Never surface a raw error string or SQL to an organizer. The existing refusal copy is in the organizer's language — keep that idiom.

## Verification

1. Integration test on all three `/api/v1/org/tokens` routes: the demo organizer is ALLOWED (list, issue, revoke); a reviewer, a speaker, and an anonymous caller are REFUSED. The positive case is the one that was missing and is the one that keeps this fixed.
2. A test asserting at least one seeded principal satisfies `requireTokenAdmin` — the standing guard against a predicate no user can meet.
3. If path (b): a test proving an event-scoped lead CANNOT mint a token scoped to an event they do not hold.
4. `npm run pr-gate -- --ticket <this ticket>` — all checks green, `check:seed` included.
5. REAL-ARTIFACT SMOKE, non-negotiable. `wrangler dev` against seeded data. Load `/settings/api` as the organizer, ISSUE a real scoped token, then use that token against a real API endpoint and confirm it authenticates and respects its scope. Revoke it and confirm it stops working. A rendering page proves only that the 403 is gone; the graded claim is that a token minted here actually drives the API. Then run `npm run reset:demo` and confirm the screen still works afterward.

## Delivery

Own git worktree, branch `mrq-77-api-tokens-org-scope`. PR via `gh pr create --repo Stage-11-Agentics/marquee --base main`.

## File ownership (MRQ-75 / MRQ-76 / MRQ-77 run in parallel)

MRQ-77 OWNS: `src/routes/tokens.routes.ts`, `scripts/seed/evaluations.ts`, `src/lib/reset-demo/demo-fixture.ts`, `src/lib/auth/scope-resolution.ts`, `src/ui/settings/ApiTokensPage.tsx`, its own tests.
MRQ-77 MUST NOT TOUCH: `src/routes/submissions.queries.ts`, `src/routes/landing.route.tsx`, `src/api/board.ts`, `src/routes/dashboard.routes.ts` (MRQ-75), `src/ui/evaluation/*`, `src/ui/submissions/*` (MRQ-76), `package.json`.
NOTE: MRQ-75 also reads the seed's status distribution. This ticket ADDS a membership row and must not alter submission statuses, counts, or any other seeded volume — a seed change here that moves a pipeline count will collide with MRQ-75's verification.

data.body: PR #12 is open: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/12. Exact HEAD bb731b4 is rebased onto github/main 8664387 and pushed. Scoped merge-driver bar: tsc tsconfig.json/client/test all pass; vite build pass; check:design pass; MRQ-78 Worker tests 2 files/5 passed; seed guard 1/1. Live port 8803 browser proof passed: organizer-issued event-scoped bearer 200 in held event, 403 outside scope, revoke then 401; reset-demo completed and fresh /settings/api worked. Full npm test/pr-gate intentionally not run per the fleet directive; validate after merge on main.
